hypothesis: Outer-time current-pitch TrackMan teachers are lower-variance historical supervision. Replacing the hard target only where a valid teacher exists, while retaining every unmatched official row with its hard label, can denoise the deployable history-only model without discarding half of the data.

difference_from_prior_lupi.soft_student: fit only matched teacher rows and discarded unmatched hard-label rows
difference_from_prior_lupi.physics_delta_student: fit only the teacher-minus-control residual and discarded unmatched hard-label rows
difference_from_prior_lupi.new_structure: fit one Brier CatBoost on the full history; matched rows use a hard/teacher mixture and unmatched rows keep the official hard target

source_gate.alpha_definition: target = (1-alpha)*physics_teacher + alpha*hard_label on teacher rows; hard_label elsewhere
source_gate.route: R only when blended with exact C; F remains exact C
source_gate.selection: maximize R gain over exact C, then full routed gain, then prefer larger alpha and smaller blend weight
pass_requirements: R point gain over exact C >= 25
routed full point gain over exact C > 0
selected hybrid must outperform the alpha=1 hard-label Brier model at the same blend weight
source_gate.on_fail: close the hybrid LUPI target axis without running 2022+
source_gate.on_pass: freeze alpha and blend weight before any 2022 metric is read

model_recipe.drop_features: identical to exact-C: pitcher_id and all raw group-specific e58 fields
